headline: Farranac Coast Shifts as Central Grinding Persists at Heavy Volume
war_summary: Since the previous edition, frontline movements flared along the western coastline as Farranac Coast recorded multiple base transitions over the past two hours, with Colonial forces securing gains around Mara and Scythe. In contrast, the island theaters that saw earlier contention—including Tempest Island, Fisherman's Row, Godcrofts, and Lykos Isle—have settled into quiet standoffs with negligible recent casualties. Across the mainland interior, relentless attritional warfare dominates without pause. Dead Lands remains the deadliest combat zone across the map, suffering over twenty-four hundred casualties in two hours as clash rates accelerate once again. Intense pressure similarly grips Weathered Expanse and Stlican Shelf, where combined two-hour losses surpassed two thousand and eleven hundred respectively amid elevated deployment traffic. Skirmishing continues steadily along the borders of Linn of Mercy, Marban Hollow, and Loch Mor, though defenses in those central sectors have held firm against ongoing bombardment without immediate shifts in strategic control.
